verdict.rationale: Docs mention building 'agents' via natural language ('Describe any workflow in your own words to create a unique agent') and no-code workflow definition (monday-docs-13,14), suggesting some no-code automation capability, but there's no direct evidence of the classic multi-step automation recipe builder monday.com is known for. Community feedback also raises broader concerns about usability and reliability that could undercut confidence in building complex automations.
